sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout table covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; selected the top-ranked current-week permissions-safety paper arXiv:2607.13718.
Read the arXiv abstract and HTML full text, extracting the 21-system taxonomy, five commercial walkthroughs, and literature-vs-commercial gap.
Translated the permissions taxonomy into tables, a policy pipeline formula, scoped-approval pseudocode, and a Mermaid enforcement graph.
Kept the article clear that this is a survey and black-box walkthrough, not a new benchmark or verified enforcement implementation.
Searched direct commentary and engineering discussions around delegated access, OAuth scopes, consent, and AI agent permission anti-patterns.
Wrote pure Markdown with TL;DR, question-style sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, Mermaid, figure evidence notes, and limitations.
